snippet.title: SKINATOR - Trailer.
snippet.description:
Defeat demons and wear their flesh to become the ultimate SKINATOR!
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4251290/Skinator/

Skinator is a turn-based combat roguelite where you build a monster from the body parts of your enemies. Arrange your six body parts to create evolving combos, break enemy limbs mid-fight and wear their flesh after you defeat them to grow in power. Presented through techno-esoteric menus with arcade-fighter flair, it’s simple to learn but endlessly deep.
